# Quarter

> Quarter is a payment firewall. It checks every outgoing business payment before it leaves the bank. A business uploads a vendor payment run (a NACHA file, a CSV, a JSON list of payments, or a check register) before sending it to its bank. Quarter matches each payment to a known vendor, runs the checks that apply to it (twenty-two in all), and holds suspicious payments for a person to approve or reject, with the reason in plain words. Only people signed in to the Quarter console approve, reject and release; an API key submits payments and reads the results. When no payment is held, release returns the file without the rejected payments, NACHA control totals recomputed; for a check register, it returns the issued-check file for Positive Pay at the bank, which the customer uploads to the bank; Quarter never sends it. Vendors can confirm their own bank details by logging in to their bank (Plaid) through a verification link, and staff call-backs are recorded with where the phone number came from. Everything goes into an audit trail, and Quarter generates a written fraud-monitoring procedure from the settings.

Quarter never holds, moves or sends money: the cleaned file goes back to the customer, who uploads it to their own bank. Account numbers are sealed at rest and responses show only the last 4 digits. The cross-customer network (account checks and fraud reports) shares counts only, never which customer verified or reported an account. Quarter gives a documented, risk-based process and the evidence it was followed, which helps a business meet Nacha's fraud-monitoring rule; it does not make anyone compliant and does not guarantee that every fraud is caught.

Status: Quarter is pre-launch, with no customers yet. Everything in these docs is built and tested: vendors and bank details, verification links, call-backs, payment runs in NACHA, CSV and JSON, check registers with Positive Pay files, one-payment checks for wires, RTP, FedNow and international payments, the twenty-two checks, decisions with two-person approval, insider controls, release, account checks, fraud reports, settings, the generated procedure, the audit log, events and signed webhooks. The read-only NetSuite connection is tested against a sample account and has not yet run against a real one. The network is built and starts empty. Before launch, Quarter gives you the API URL, and an admin creates API keys in the console.

Every docs page below is plain Markdown. The whole set is one file at [/llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt). The exact contract of every route is an OpenAPI 3.1 document at `GET $QUARTER_API_URL/openapi.json`, which needs no key. Examples use `$QUARTER_API_URL` for the API URL and `$QUARTER_API_KEY` for the key. Test keys start with `qk_test_`, live keys with `qk_live_`; send them as a Bearer token on every `/v1` route and keep them on a server. Deciding, releasing, call-backs, fraud reports, settings and the yearly review take the session token of a person signed in (`$QUARTER_SESSION_TOKEN` in the examples); an API key there answers `403 session_required`. The `/verify` routes are public and take the token in the link instead. Start with the [quickstart](/docs/quickstart.md); look up any finding code in [checks](/docs/checks.md). Sign-in, members, API keys and billing serve the console and are described only in the OpenAPI document.

## Get started

- [Overview](/docs.md): Check every outgoing vendor payment before it leaves your bank. Hold the suspicious ones for a person, with the reason in plain words.
- [Quickstart](/docs/quickstart.md): Add a vendor, upload a small payment run with a test key, and read the result after a person decides the held payment and releases the run.

## Guides

- [Vendors and bank details](/docs/vendors.md): Add the people you pay, record their bank details, and see why a change of bank details holds payments until it is confirmed.
- [Confirming bank details](/docs/verification.md): Two ways to confirm a vendor's bank details: a link where the vendor logs in to their own bank, or a recorded call-back to a number you already had.
- [Payment runs](/docs/payment-runs.md): Upload a NACHA file, a CSV, a list of payments or a check register, and get every payment back clear or held, with its findings.
- [Decisions and release](/docs/releases.md): Approve or reject each held payment with a reason, then release the run and get back the file to send to your bank, or its Positive Pay file.
- [Payment checks](/docs/payment-checks.md): Check one wire, RTP, FedNow, international or ACH payment before someone keys it into the bank portal.
- [Checks and settings](/docs/checks.md): The twenty-two checks Quarter runs on payments, the exact message each gives, and the settings that decide whether it holds, warns or is off.
- [Account checks and fraud reports](/docs/network.md): Check bank details before you pay them, and report an account used in a fraud against you. The network shares counts, never names.
- [Compliance and insider controls](/docs/compliance.md): The written procedure, its yearly review, the audit log, and the controls against payments steered by someone inside.
- [NetSuite](/docs/netsuite.md): Bring your NetSuite vendors and their bank details into Quarter every hour, and check every open vendor bill with a hold that NetSuite itself enforces.

## Reference

- [Webhooks and events](/docs/webhooks.md): Event types, the signed delivery format, how to verify quarter-signature, and how retries work.
- [Errors](/docs/errors.md): The error shape, the error types and their HTTP status, and every error code the api returns.
